## Vegetation

```{r}
#| label: setup-ndxi
#| include: false
if (file.exists("_quarto.yml")) here::i_am("tasks/ndxi/charts/index.qmd")
if (!exists("aoi")) {
  USE_GCS <<- FALSE
  source(here::here("core/R/setup.R"))
}
```

```{r}
#| label: ndvi-data
#| output: false
ndvi_file <- list.files(tabular_dir, pattern = "ndvi_area\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
if (length(ndvi_file) > 0) {
  ojs_define(ndvi_area = read.csv(ndvi_file[1]))
  ojs_define(ndvi_city = city)
} else {
  ojs_define(ndvi_area = NULL)
  ojs_define(ndvi_city = city)
}
```

```{ojs}
//| label: ndvi-plot
//| output: true
import { plot_ndvi_area, setCity, setWidth } from "../../core/ojs/plots.js"

setCity(ndvi_city)
setWidth(640)

ndvi_area ? plot_ndvi_area(ndvi_area, {height: 350}) : html`<p><strong>No NDVI data available</strong></p>`
```
